title: wood-plan project file
description: Schema for .wood project files used by the wood-plan tool.

description.description: Optional longer description of the project.

unit.description: Measurement unit used throughout the file.

materials.description: Stock materials available at the lumber yard.

elements.description: Pieces that will be cut from stock material.

material.description: A stock material (e.g. a pine board available in a specific size).

id.description: Unique identifier for this material, referenced by elements.

length.description: Available stock length in project units.

cost_per_length.description: Cost per unit of stock length.

unit.description: Override the project unit for this material only.

element.description: A named piece that will be cut from stock material.

id.description: Unique identifier for this element, referenced in joints.

material.description: ID of the stock material this piece is cut from.

label.description: Human-readable display name for cut lists and reports.

quantity.description: Number of identical pieces to cut.

notes.description: Optional fabrication notes for this piece.

joint_position.description: Where a joint sits on an element.

edge.description: Which face/edge of the element the joint is on.

offset.description: Distance from the named edge in project units.

type.description:
Joint type.

dado – rectangular channel cut across the grain to seat a shelf/panel
rabbet – notch along the edge or end of a board (one-sided dado)
butt – two square-cut pieces meet face-to-face or end-to-face
miter – both pieces cut at a matching angle (typically 45°)
half_lap – half the thickness removed from each piece so they sit flush
box_joint – interlocking rectangular fingers along the end of a board
mortise_tenon – a projecting tenon fits into a matching mortise hole
bridle – open mortise-and-tenon; the tenon slides into a forked end
tongue_groove – a tongue (ridge) fits into a matching groove
spline – a thin strip of wood fits into slots in both faces
dovetail – trapezoidal interlocking fingers; very strong and decorative
pocket – angled hole driven with a pocket-screw jig
biscuit – oval compressed-wood wafer glued into matching slots
dowel – cylindrical wooden pins align and reinforce the joint

from_element.description: ID of the element the joint is cut into or originates from.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the joint.

depth.description: Depth of the cut in project units (e.g. dado depth).

width.description: Width of the cut in project units.

fastener.description: Primary fastener used to secure the joint.
